插入语与同位语:长难句打断点: 双逗号/双破折号间的插入语可先跳过;同位语对名词进一步说明,帮助拆解长难句。
插入语:however, in fact, of course, as a result 等独立成分|同位语(名词短语):my friend Tom|同位语从句:the fact/news/idea that...(that 不作成分)|非限制性定语从句也起插入打断作用|拆句技巧:先去插入语找主干,再逐层还原|破折号与冒号后的内容常为解释说明
The news that our team won the match excited everyone.
column3: 我们队获胜的消息让所有人兴奋。

插入语与同位语:长难句打断点: Mr Smith, our headmaster, will give a speech tomorrow.
column3: 史密斯先生——我们的校长——明天将发表演讲。

插入语与同位语:长难句打断点: This solution, in my opinion, is the most practical.
column3: 依我看,这个方案最实用。

# title: The fact ___ he failed the exam surprised nobody.
column4: 同位语从句,that 不作成分。

# title: Word came ___ the mayor would visit our school.
column4: word(消息)后的同位语从句用 that。

# title: The proposal ___ the two sides discussed yesterday was accepted.
column4: discussed 缺宾语,是定语从句,用 which。

# title: Tom, ___ opinion I value most, disagreed with the plan.
column4: whose opinion 定语从句表所属。

# title: ____, the experiment turned out to be a success.
插入语与同位语:长难句打断点: To our surprise|To we surprise|For our surprising|Surprising us
column4: To our surprise 为固定插入语。

# title: The thought ___ he might be wrong never crossed his mind.
column4: thought 后同位语从句,句子成分完整,用 that。
